key_insight: Enhanced state features and reward shaping improve deep reinforcement learning flow control across synthetic jet positions, achieving 8–34% drag reduction at Reynolds numbers of 100–400.
engineering_relevance: More adaptive synthetic jet control could reduce drag and energy use while suppressing lift fluctuations and vortex shedding.
method: Train deep reinforcement learning controllers across Reynolds numbers and synthetic jet positions.
Enhance dynamic state features to improve flow-state representation.
Reshape rewards to balance multiple flow-control objectives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 8–34% drag reduction over Reynolds numbers of 100–400, with improved control across jet positions compared with the foundational framework.
watch_item: Performance beyond Reynolds numbers of 100–400 and transfer to physical experiments are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Toward fully stabilized flow control using deep reinforcement learning
